jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Analyst - Summer 2027 Graduates
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Traba’s mission is to empower businesses and workers to reach their full productivity and potential. Traba is a technology company that is revolutionizing the broken staffing industry through a marketplace that connects light industrial businesses with reliable talent while providing workers with flexible and meaningful opportunities. By connecting both, new levels of productivity, earning potential, and avenues for growth are unlocked. We’re proud to be backed by the world’s best investors, such as Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.

We are seeking an experienced & entrepreneurial rockstar to run our two-sided labor marketplace in one of our markets. You'll be a key member of our Market Operations team.

As a Strategy & Operations Analyst, you will work closely with our workers. You'll wear multiple hats to ensure the success of your market in terms of growth, marketplace health, and profitability and you'll be a cross-functional influential partner to the many teams that are critical to the successful execution of your plan, including Sales, Central Operations, Tech, Product, Marketing and more!

What You'll Do:

  • Champion Operational Excellence: Become the go-to expert on Traba’s daily operations, ensuring everything runs like a well-oiled machine while continuously seeking ways to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Strategize for Success: Think big and dive deep – identify areas where our processes can be streamlined, and craft actionable plans to drive improvement and eliminate inefficiencies.

  • Master Marketplace Dynamics: Take charge of Traba’s marketplace supply by designing and executing innovative user acquisition, retention, and reactivation campaigns that meet both current and future demand.

  • Elevate Business Performance: Develop and implement strategies that not only boost operational efficiency but also elevate customer satisfaction and overall business performance.

  • Create Impactful Tools & Insights: Build powerful tools, craft insightful analyses, and establish reporting structures that surface key insights, enabling cross-functional teams to make data-driven decisions and achieve strategic goals.

  • Be the Glue that Connects: Maintain strong communication and collaboration across Operations, Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, ensuring everyone is aligned and working towards shared success.

What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in economics, business, finance, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • New grad - 1+ years of experience in dynamic roles such as consulting, investment banking, and 1+ years in strategy/operations at a fast-paced tech company or startup

  • A methodical, process-driven mentality that is focused on both accuracy and efficiency.

  • An eagerness to roll up your sleeves and get into the details of processes.

  • High EQ and a resilient mentality that allows you to quickly overcome challenges and setbacks.

  • Exceptional communication skills and an ability to thrive in fast-paced environments under pressure.

  • Excellent organization, time management, and prioritization skills.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with SQL and no code tools like Retool, experience working with product/engineering teams.

Benefits:

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 💰 Competitive salary

  • 🩺 100% Paid health, dental & vision coverage

  • 🍽️ Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass & stocked kitchen for NY employees

  • 🚍 Commuter benefit

  • 🎤 Team building events

  • 🏋🏽 Gympass benefit

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teledoc Health

Salary Range Details:

The compensation range for this position is $85,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets.

Our Values

Dream Big - We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

Olympian’s Work Ethic - Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field.

Growth Mindset - We confront the toughest challenges head-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience.

Customer Obsession - We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high-quality products and services that solve these often overlooked communities’ problems.

Light industrial flexible staffing is a $50B labor market that encompasses entry-level jobs in warehouses & distribution centers. These workers pack boxes, load trucks, and manage warehouse operations to keep supply chains running at peak efficiency.

jobs.title: Customer On-Site - Laredo, TX
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Customer On-Site, you will serve as the main point of contact between Traba's workforce and our client's on-site leadership team. You'll provide dedicated operational oversight to drive service delivery and act as the face of Traba inside the facility — managing day-to-day worker support, coordinating onboarding and scheduling, and ensuring smooth communication between workers, site supervisors, and Traba's internal operations team.

This role requires professionalism, bilingual communication, and the ability to build strong relationships while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced warehouse / manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities

  • Worker & Client Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with site supervisors and workers, ensuring both receive timely updates, feedback, and support. Serve as the primary relationship owner with supervisors and key points of contact at the facility.

  • On-Site Coordination: Facilitate worker onboarding, introductions, and first-day check-ins; coordinate interviews and start schedules for new hires (e.g., forklift operators). Oversee worker vetting, drug testing, and onboarding end-to-end.

  • Worker Support & Performance: Assist workers with clock-ins, pay questions, and performance feedback; manage worker performance on-site and escalate issues to internal teams as needed.

  • Communication & Reporting: Act as the bridge between the client site, Traba Ops, and Worker Support teams — communicating key updates, attendance issues, or staffing changes clearly and professionally.

  • Issue Resolution: Identify and flag worker performance concerns or site challenges early, working proactively to resolve them. Handle incident management and escalations.

  • Operational Execution: Support day-to-day site operations, ensuring adequate staffing coverage and a positive worker experience. Own shift and schedule management, and distribute and manage PPE.

  • Account Growth: Identify and drive wallet expansion opportunities within the account.

Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) required.

  • 1–2+ years of experience in operations or customer-facing environments, including but not limited to: staffing, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, food service, teaching, or on-site coordination.

  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills (email and in-person).

  • Professional demeanor and ability to represent Traba with both workers and client stakeholders.

  • Polished and presentable in a customer-facing environment.

  • Warm, friendly, and approachable, with the ability to coach workers and confidently enforce standards.

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and a proactive problem solver.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic warehouse environments.

Compensation

Competitive hourly base pay plus performance-based incentives tied to attendance, shift completion, and overall account health.

jobs.title: Field Operator - Columbia, MD
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Field Operator, you will serve as Traba's in-market operational hands — focused on recruiting, onboarding, and preparing workers for placement across the market. Rather than being anchored to a single customer, you'll support the broader market and may interact with multiple customer sites as volume and coverage needs dictate.

You'll be the local face of Traba to our workforce: building community partnerships, running onboarding sessions, and making sure every worker is vetted, prepared, and ready to succeed on their first shift. This role requires professionalism, bilingual communication, strong recruiting instincts, and the flexibility to flex across worker funnel needs in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Worker Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with workers across the market — owning the experience from recruiting through placement and providing timely updates, feedback, and support.

About the role
Traba is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and people-oriented Onsite Operations Manager to oversee our workforce operations at a key customer location in the San Jose area. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for our onsite workforce, managing employee onboarding, scheduling, attendance, performance, and day-to-day employment matters. You will also work closely with customer leadership and Traba's internal operations and recruiting teams to ensure reliable staffing coverage, strong employee engagement, and exceptional service delivery. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, takes ownership of problems, communicates effectively, and is passionate about building high-performing teams.

This is a full-time, on-site role (40+ hours per week) in the San Jose/Milpitas area. Coverage may expand to multiple regional locations.

Responsibilities

  • Workforce Management & Employee Relations

    • Serve as manager and primary point of contact for assigned employees on all employment matters, including onboarding, scheduling, timekeeping, pay, benefits, leave, and performance.

    • Hire, onboard, and terminate employees for the account, and lead orientation so every worker understands expectations, policies, and safety requirements before day one.

    • Conduct check-ins, performance reviews, and coaching, and make and carry out disciplinary decisions, keeping documentation that supports each employment action.

    • Investigate and resolve employee concerns using independent judgment, and build relationships that improve engagement, attendance, and retention.

  • Scheduling, Attendance & Operational Execution

    • Coordinate schedules and staffing assignments to meet customer headcount requirements across multiple shifts and sites.

    • Direct real-time responses to attendance gaps and no-shows, and guide recruiting and operations partners on replacements and changes in demand.

    • Ensure employee schedules and working hours comply with applicable meal, rest, overtime, and wage-and-hour requirements per California law.

    • Manage shift-support coverage with alternate supervisors.

  • Customer Relationship & Communication

    • Serve as Traba’s onsite leader and primary liaison to customer operations leadership and onsite stakeholders.

    • Proactively communicate staffing trends, performance concerns, and operational risks, along with recommended solutions.

    • Own resolution of customer requests and escalations, directing internal Traba teams as needed.

    • Lead regular operational reviews focused on improving service quality and workforce reliability.

  • Compliance, Safety & Continuous Improvement

    • Ensure employees complete required screening, training, and site-access documentation before starting, and decide when they are cleared to work.

    • Enforce customer safety, security, and conduct standards, taking employment action when they aren’t met.

    • Lead the response to workplace incidents and complaints, including investigation, documentation, and required reporting, in partnership with Traba HR and compliance.

    • Analyze workforce metrics and design process improvements to build a safe, accountable, high-performing team.

Requirements

  • 3+ years supervising hourly teams of 15+ people in warehouse, manufacturing, light industrial, or lab settings

  • Hands-on experience hiring, coaching, and disciplining frontline employees

  • Working knowledge of California wage-and-hour rules: daily overtime, meal and rest breaks, and premium pay

  • Experience managing schedules, attendance, and time approvals against weekly deadlines

  • Strong written documentation habits for coaching notes, incident reports, and investigation summaries

  • Availability for early morning, evening, and weekend coverage on a rotating schedule

  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation between the San Jose and Milpitas sites

  • Comfortable working on a production floor, including standing and walking for long periods and wearing ESD or cleanroom garments when required

  • Able to pass a background check and sign a confidentiality agreement

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in staffing, contingent workforce, or vendor-managed labor programs

  • Background in semiconductor, data center, electronics, or server/rack manufacturing

  • Familiarity with ESD (ANSI/ESD S20.20), lockout/tagout, NFPA 70E awareness, and forklift certification programs

  • Experience in secure or export-controlled facilities

  • OSHA 10/30 or Cal/OSHA training

  • Bilingual (Spanish, Vietnamese, or Tagalog a plus)

  • Comfortable with Slack, Google Workspace, and app-based workforce tools

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Customer On-Site, you will serve as the main point of contact between Traba's workforce and our client's on-site leadership team. You'll provide dedicated operational oversight to drive service delivery and act as the face of Traba for the account — managing day-to-day worker support, coordinating onboarding and scheduling, and ensuring smooth communication between workers, site supervisors, and Traba's internal operations team.

This is a flexible, part-time to full-time role (20–40 hours per week) focused on worker vetting, worker support, and client support. In-person work centers on running candidate tours at the facility; much of the remaining work can be completed remotely.

This role requires professionalism, strong communication, and the ability to build strong relationships while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced warehouse / logistics environment.

Responsibilities

20-40 hours per week.

Responsibilities

  • Vetting & Placement: Facilitate candidate tours 4+ times per week — vet candidates, take headshots, and run drug tests. Keep the candidate tracker current with notes, rankings, and schedule preferences, and follow up with every candidate after their tour.

  • Worker & Client Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with site supervisors, HR, and workers, ensuring both receive timely updates, feedback, and support. Serve as the primary relationship owner with supervisors and key points of contact at the facility.

  • On-Site Coordination: Facilitate worker onboarding, introductions, and first-day check-ins; send placed workers their onboarding materials and coordinate start schedules for new hires. Oversee worker vetting, drug testing, and onboarding end-to-end.

  • Worker Support & Performance: Run a rotating schedule of worker check-ins (after the first shift, first week, 30 days, and every few weeks after) to drive retention and attendance. Assist workers with clock-ins, pay questions, and performance feedback; manage worker performance and escalate issues to internal teams as needed.

  • Communication & Reporting: Act as the bridge between the client site, Traba Ops, and Worker Support teams — responding promptly to client emails about worker coaching, incidents, and issues, and communicating key updates, attendance issues, or staffing changes clearly and professionally.

  • Issue Resolution: Identify and flag worker performance concerns or site challenges early, working proactively to resolve them before they reach site leadership. Handle incident management and escalations.

  • Recruiting Support: Support grassroots and in-person recruiting efforts, and actively collect worker and supervisor referrals to keep the candidate pipeline warm.

  • Account Growth: Identify and drive wallet expansion opportunities within the account.

Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

  • English required.

  • Availability for 20–40 hours per week, including in-person candidate tours several times per week, and responsiveness to client emails between 9am–9pm.

  • 1–2+ years of experience in operations or customer-facing environments, including but not limited to: staffing, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, food service, teaching, or on-site coordination.

  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills (email and in-person).

  • Professional demeanor and ability to represent Traba with both workers and client stakeholders.

  • Polished and presentable in a customer-facing environment.

  • Warm, friendly, and approachable, with the ability to coach workers and confidently enforce standards.

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and a proactive problem solver.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic warehouse environments.

Compensation

Competitive hourly base pay plus performance-based incentives tied to attendance, shift completion, and overall account health.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Field Operator, you will serve as Traba's in-market operational hands — focused on recruiting, onboarding, and preparing workers for placement across the market. Rather than being anchored to a single customer, you'll support the broader market and may interact with multiple customer sites as volume and coverage needs dictate.

You'll be the local face of Traba to our workforce: building community partnerships, running onboarding sessions, and making sure every worker is vetted, prepared, and ready to succeed on their first shift. This role requires professionalism, strong recruiting instincts, and the flexibility to flex across worker funnel needs in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Worker Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with workers across the market — owning the experience from recruiting through placement and providing timely updates, feedback, and support.

  • Community & Partner Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with workforce centers, community organizations, and local partners to drive worker pipeline and brand presence in the market.

  • Worker Vetting & Onboarding: Oversee worker vetting, drug testing, and onboarding end-to-end, including running large group onboarding sessions when volume calls for it.

  • Worker Funnel Management: Manage the full worker funnel — sourcing, screening, scheduling, and converting applicants into placement-ready workers.

  • New Start Scheduling: Coordinate interviews and start schedules for new hires across customer sites, ensuring workers are matched to the right opportunities at the right time.

  • PPE & On-Site Support: Distribute and manage PPE, and provide on-site presence at customer facilities as needed to support new starts, escalations, or peak coverage.

  • Communication & Reporting: Maintain consistent, proactive feedback loops with Traba HQ — flagging market trends, funnel issues, or coverage risks early.

Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

  • English required.

  • 1–2+ years of experience in operations or customer-facing environments, including but not limited to: staffing, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, food service, teaching, or on-site coordination.

  • Strong recruiting instincts and the ability to source, screen, and convert candidates.

  • Comfortable running large group onboarding sessions and presenting in front of workers.

  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills (email and in-person).

  • Professional demeanor and ability to represent Traba with workers, partners, and client stakeholders.

  • Flexible and adaptable — able to shift priorities and locations as market needs evolve.

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and a proactive problem solver.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic warehouse and field environments.

Compensation

Competitive hourly base pay plus performance-based incentives tied to worker onboarding and successful placements.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Traba is building the AI operating system for the industrial supply chain - the network of warehouses, manufacturers, logistics providers, and workers behind the physical goods people rely on every day.

 

We started by tackling labor, supplying industrial businesses with consistent, reliable temporary workforces, and quickly became the fastest growing staffing company in America.

 

Since then, we've expanded our suite of AI agents to help logistics providers, manufacturers, 3PLs, and other industrial businesses fully automate their manual workflows, derive insights from their data streams, and transform their decision intelligence.

 

Our mission is to build a world where the global supply chain operates at peak efficiency.

 

We’re proud to be backed by some of the world’s best investors, including Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst.

 

You'll build the AI agents themselves—the harnesses, evals, orchestration, and model strategy the rest of Traba's product runs on. We're seeking an entrepreneurial Senior AI Agent Engineer to join as a founding member of the Agents team and build the next layer of Traba's product—an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. (Our Applied AI team puts these agents to work across the product; you own the agents and infrastructure they depend on.) You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agent harnesses on top of frontier models, and turn what you learn in the field into durable product. You will partner closely with our CTO, product, and our operators to take 0-to-1 ideas to scaled deployments.

 

About You

  • Builder with an AI operator's instinct. You've shipped real product on top of LLMs—not just chat wrappers. You've designed agent harnesses, structured tools, written evals, and tuned prompts against production traces. You think in capability, reliability, and unit economics—not just whether the model says the right thing.

  • Domain-immersed. You enjoy time with the people who do the work—learning an industry's vocabulary, edge cases, and operational tempo—and let that shape what you build.

  • High-agency in ambiguity. Dropped into a fuzzy customer problem with a half-formed hypothesis and a deadline, you scope, build, evaluate, and ship without waiting for a spec.

  • Sweat both ends of the stack. You move between prompt iteration, eval design, backend services, and customer-facing UI in the same week, and you care about evals that catch regressions and traces that are easy to debug.

     
 

You Will

  • Embed with customers and operators to understand how supply chains run today—then design and ship agents that take meaningful work off their plate.

  • Build production agent systems on frontier LLMs: tool use, sub-agents, retrieval, structured outputs, MCP servers, and the orchestration that ties them together.

  • Own evaluation as a first-class discipline—datasets from real traces, rubrics and graders, experiments, and improvements you can prove move the needle.

  • Architect the data, services, and APIs the agent layer depends on—integrating our internal systems with customers' WMS, TMS, and ERP environments.

  • Codify repeatable deployment patterns so each new customer rollout is faster than the last.

     
 

You Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering, with 1+ year shipping LLM- or agent-based features into production.

  • Strong in Python and/or TypeScript/Node.js, and comfortable designing APIs, distributed systems, and data models in PostgreSQL.

  • Hands-on with the modern agent stack: production-scale prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, orchestration patterns, and frontier model APIs.

  • A track record of building in fast, ambiguous environments—ideally at a vertical AI, AI-agent, forward-deployed, or data-product company.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication—you can run a customer workshop in the morning and write a clean design doc in the afternoon.

     
 

Benefits

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 💰 Competitive Salary

  • 🩺 100% Paid health, dental & vision coverage

  • 🍽️ Dinner Provided via DoorDash, free DashPass & stocked kitchen for NY employees

  • 🚍 Commuter benefit

  • 🏋🏽 Gympass Benefit

  • ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, HealthAdvocate, Teledoc Health

 

Salary Range Details

The compensation range for this position is set between $200,000 and $240,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.

 

Equal Opportunity Employer

Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets.

 

Our Values

Dream Big - We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long-term value for short-term results.

Olympian’s Work Ethic - Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field.

Growth Mindset - We confront the toughest challenges head-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience.

Customer Obsession - We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems

jobs.title: Customer On-Site - Keller, TX
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

As a Customer On-Site, you will serve as the main point of contact between Traba's workforce and our client's on-site leadership team. You'll provide dedicated operational oversight to drive service delivery and act as the face of Traba inside the facility — managing day-to-day worker support, coordinating onboarding and scheduling, and ensuring smooth communication between workers, site supervisors, and Traba's internal operations team.

This role requires professionalism, bilingual communication, and the ability to build strong relationships while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced warehouse / manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities

  • Worker & Client Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with site supervisors and workers, ensuring both receive timely updates, feedback, and support. Serve as the primary relationship owner with supervisors and key points of contact at the facility.

  • On-Site Coordination: Facilitate worker onboarding, introductions, and first-day check-ins; coordinate interviews and start schedules for new hires (e.g., forklift operators). Oversee worker vetting, drug testing, and onboarding end-to-end.

  • Worker Support & Performance: Assist workers with clock-ins, pay questions, and performance feedback; manage worker performance on-site and escalate issues to internal teams as needed.

  • Communication & Reporting: Act as the bridge between the client site, Traba Ops, and Worker Support teams — communicating key updates, attendance issues, or staffing changes clearly and professionally.

  • Issue Resolution: Identify and flag worker performance concerns or site challenges early, working proactively to resolve them. Handle incident management and escalations.

  • Operational Execution: Support day-to-day site operations, ensuring adequate staffing coverage and a positive worker experience. Own shift and schedule management, and distribute and manage PPE.

  • Account Growth: Identify and drive wallet expansion opportunities within the account.

Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) required.

  • 1–2+ years of experience in operations or customer-facing environments, including but not limited to: staffing, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, food service, teaching, or on-site coordination.

  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills (email and in-person).

  • Professional demeanor and ability to represent Traba with both workers and client stakeholders.

  • Polished and presentable in a customer-facing environment.

  • Warm, friendly, and approachable, with the ability to coach workers and confidently enforce standards.

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and a proactive problem solver.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic warehouse environments.

Compensation

Competitive hourly base pay plus performance-based incentives tied to attendance, shift completion, and overall account health.
